description: These Banana Oat Breakfast Cookies are so easy to make! All four of my kids loved them! Share this recipe with a busy mama! 😋 Ingredients  •2 cups quick oats •½ tsp ground cinnamon •¼ tsp salt •½ cup peanut butter •½ tsp vanilla extract •2 large bananas mashed  •1/3 cup chocolate chips Directions  1)Preheat oven to 350°F 2)In a large bowl, combine all of your ingredients and stir until combined.  3)Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and drop a spoonful of the mixture on the the sheet. Shape into a circle and flatten it down a little.  3)Bake for 14 minutes. Let cool and Enjoy! ____ #toddlerfood #easybreakfast #breakfast #blw #momsoftiktok #viral
transcript: Here's an easy toddler breakfast that they will actually want to eat. All you need is oats, banana, peanut butter, chocolate chips, vanilla and cinnamon. Mix it together and then add small scoops to a baking sheet, pat them down and then bake in the oven.
